ety.text: Inherited from Old Hindi काहू (kāhū), काहु (kāhu), from Sauraseni Prakrit, from Sanskrit कक्षे (kákṣe, “in the armpit”), locative singular of कक्ष (kákṣa, “armpit”), from Proto-Indo-Aryan *káṭṣas, from Proto-Indo-Iranian *káćšas, from Proto-Indo-European *kóḱsos (“joint”). Compare Deccani کو (kū), Braj कौ (kau), Awadhi का (kā), Bhojpuri का (kā), Punjabi ਕੂੰ (kū̃) / کُوں (kūṉ), Bengali -কে (-ke), Assamese -ক (-k).
